import unittest
from stats import mean, median, percentile

class T(unittest.TestCase):
    def test_mean(self): self.assertEqual(mean([1, 2, 3, 4]), 2.5)
    def test_median_even(self): self.assertEqual(median([4, 1, 3, 2]), 2.5)
    def test_median_odd(self): self.assertEqual(median([3, 1, 2]), 2)
    def test_p100(self): self.assertEqual(percentile([1, 2, 3, 4, 5], 100), 5)
    def test_empty(self):
        with self.assertRaises(ValueError): mean([])

if __name__ == "__main__": unittest.main()
